CustomField.description: Wire-fraud control, migrated 1 to 1 from Task.Verbal_Verification_Completed__c: must be true before a wire verification item can be closed. This is evidence, not a status - it records that a human made the call, and it is the reason a wire item cannot be completed from a list view or a data loader.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick only after you have verbally confirmed the wiring instructions by phone, using a number you looked up yourself.
CustomField.label: Verbal Verification Completed
